PERFORMANCE / CONTEXT

A number needs context.

Repository benchmark snapshot, 23 August 2026: NovaModel initialization averaged 1.777 μs across 120 measured values, with a sample standard deviation of 0.047 μs.

Environment: CPython 3.12.13, AMD Ryzen 7 5800H, Linux; pyperf 2.10.0. The displayed 563k initializations per second is the reciprocal of the measured mean.

This measures model construction. It does not measure HTTP throughput, SQL, validation on save, or caching, and is not a new benchmark of the 0.6.3 release.
